tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: forecast_as_issued
tools.description: Archived JMA prefectural weather forecast as issued. Give an area and at (forecast in effect then) or issued_at (exact JMA issue time). Returns JMA's bulletin as published (Japanese weather text, wind, waves, 6-hour rain probability, temperatures) with report_datetime (JMA's issue time) apart from f

tools.name: forecast_issuances
tools.description: Which prefectural weather forecasts did JMA issue for an area between two times? Lists each archived issuance (JMA issue time, transmission time, our fetch time, scheduled/unscheduled/correction/cancellation, bulletin URL and SHA-256) with coverage gaps where JMA's feed could not be read. Free windo

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 30 days after settlement.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_receipt" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement." → after: "Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 30 days after settlement."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
